name: Taylor
gaps: Gap. No county-hosted parcel polygon service for Taylor County. The property appraiser portal (https://qpublic.net/fl/taylor/) is qPublic/Schneider or a search page, not an open parcel GIS, and was not used as a geometry source.

Statewide FDOR cadastral, Florida DOH EHWATER, and SRWMD republished rolls exist and were not wired. No municipal zoning FeatureServer was confirmed. Eligible tracts in this county stay eligible and are not designated QOZs.
